title: RARP: Finding Your Own Address
subtitle: How a diskless machine learns its own IP address
summary: RARP lets a machine that knows only its hardware address ask a server for its IP address.

plainLanguage.summary: A computer shouts its name tag number and a helper tells it its home address.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: This is the inverse of ARP in RFC 826.

references.text: Plummer, D., "An Ethernet Address Resolution Protocol", RFC 826, November 1982.
